labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory about Pygments, not Rich code

items.body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency (CVE-2026-4539, in its `AdlLexer`), not code in Rich, so it is labelled as an upstream dependency issue. The fix belongs with the Pygments project, which maintains that lexer.

If you think Rich itself is affected, please report it privately as described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
